message.content:
Based on my search, here's what I found about free satellite radio options:

## Free Satellite Radio Options

### 1. SiriusXM Free Access (Ad-Supported)
SiriusXM now offers a **free, ad-supported tier** called **SiriusXM Free Access** for vehicles with SiriusXM 360L platform radios. This includes:
- Around two dozen free music streams (alternative rock, pop, hip hop, country)
- Four sports channels: ESPN Radio, Fox Sports, NBC Sports Audio, Infinity Sports Network
- Cable news simulcasts (CNN, MSNBC)
- Comedy channels (Comedy Central Radio, Conan O'Brien Radio)
- NPR, PRX, Fox News Headlines, The Catholic Channel, BYU Radio

**Important limitations:**
- Only available after a free trial expires (typically when purchasing a used/new vehicle)
- Limited to one vehicle; cannot transfer to another radio
- No streaming access through SiriusXM apps
- You must use the service at least once every 60 days or it gets permanently cancelled

### 2. Free Trial Offers
- **SiriusXM** regularly offers **4 months free** for new subscribers to their streaming service (then $9.99/month)
- Many new vehicles come with **free trial subscriptions** (typically 3-6 months) for satellite radio

### 3. Free-to-Air (FTA) Satellite Radio
- **FTA satellite radio** exists in some regions, particularly internationally (like India), where you can receive unencrypted radio channels using a DTH antenna and free-to-air set-top box
- These are typically public broadcasting channels, not the same as SiriusXM-style commercial satellite radio

### 4. Alternative: Free Streaming Radio Services
While not true "satellite radio," several free alternatives exist:
- **Spotify Free** (ad-supported streaming)
- **Pandora Free** (ad-supported)
- **iHeartRadio** (free with ads)
- Traditional **HD Radio** (free, improved digital broadcast radio in vehicles)

## Key Reality Check
True commercial satellite radio (like SiriusXM) is primarily a **subscription-based service**. The main "free" options are:
- Limited ad-supported tiers with restrictions
- Promotional free trials
- FTA satellite channels (mostly international/public broadcasting, not premium content)

3. https://www.sportingnews.com/us/tsn/news/siriusxm-offer-four-months-free-radio-streaming-deal/76d08dbad4551370029a18e3
4. https://www.freedish.in/2024/01/how-to-listen-to-satellite-radio-in.html
5. https://www.tvradiotips.com/what-is-satellite-radio/
6. https://www.usedcars.com/advice/tips/hd-radio-vs-satellite-radio-24
